Method of Attack: Encrypts data on the computer and appends the .Jnec extension to files
Generates a unique Gmail address per victim for ransom payment and key delivery
Delivered via a malicious WinRAR archive exploiting CVE-2018-20250
Drops malware into Windows Startup folder under the name GoogleUpdate.exe to persist on reboot
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with vulnerable versions of WinRAR (all versions released over the past 19 years except 5.70 and newer)
Attack Vector: Extraction of a malicious archive (vk_4221345.rar) using vulnerable WinRAR versions
